dimensions.name: Technical accuracy
dimensions.description: Guidance is correct for the customer's API version, environment, and configuration.
dimensions.coaching: Pair on API debugging: reproduce with the customer's request, compare against docs, confirm before replying.

dimensions.name: Troubleshooting
dimensions.description: Gathers evidence (request IDs, timestamps, payloads, logs) before concluding, and isolates the cause.
dimensions.coaching: Use the evidence checklist in each runbook and ask for request IDs and timestamps in the first reply.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.description: Clear, empathetic, sets expectations and next update time, no jargon without explanation.
dimensions.coaching: Review two strong replies together and practice the 'what we know / what we are doing / next update' format.

dimensions.name: Process and documentation
dimensions.description: Correct priority, category, internal notes, escalation template, and no sensitive data in the ticket.
dimensions.coaching: Walk through the escalation template and the data handling rules; spot check tickets for two weeks.

dimensions.name: Ownership
dimensions.description: Drives the ticket to resolution, follows up on escalations, and links or writes a KB article.
dimensions.coaching: Set a daily check on escalated tickets and agree on one KB article to write from recent work.

auto_fail_examples: Customer secret, API key, or personal data pasted into a ticket or Slack thread
Incorrect guidance that caused customer impact
P1 not escalated to on-call engineering
